text: A Calcuttan living in Berlin told his parents there were no protests in the city on Oct. 31, while a Calcuttan residing in Düsseldorf said she heard reports of an emergency declaration and stayed indoors.

sources.title: Calcuttans encounter an unfamiliar face of Europe, Gen Z protests reshape streets - Telegraph India
sources.articleText:
Calcuttans encounter an unfamiliar face of Europe, Gen Z protests reshape streets
Another Calcuttan, who travelled to Paris for an art exhibition, found that the event had been cancelled for its final two days because of protests
Police officers walk amid tear gas near the Eiffel Tower as protesters take part in a demonstration in Paris on October 31. (Reuters picture)
A Calcuttan living in Düsseldorf, Germany, stayed indoors on October 31 after hearing reports of protests and an “emergency” being declared in the city.
Another Calcuttan, who travelled to Paris for an art exhibition, found that the event had been cancelled for its final two days because of protests.
A wave of protests swept several European cities over the weekend, following recent Gen Z-led marches. Anger over the rising cost of living, inadequate public services and other issues fuelled the demonstrations.
